title: Evaluating Cellular-Composition Effects and Incremental Predictive Value in Periodontitis Transcriptomic Gene Signatures
description: Single-cell cellular-composition baselines (150-gene GSE152042 and 360-gene GSE164241 marker catalogs), Affymetrix GPL570 CEL-level overlap and scan-date audit tables (GSE10334 vs. GSE16134), fixed-identity matched random-panel gene lists, benchmarking and plotting scripts, and complete numerical outputs accompanying the manuscript.
